name: Machu Picchu
description: Inca stone citadel set on a mountain ridge above the Urubamba. Timed tickets required.

name: Sacsayhuamán
description: Massive zigzag stone walls overlook Cusco from the northern hills.

name: Lima Cathedral
description: A colonial cathedral faces Plaza Mayor in Lima’s historic centre.

name: Chan Chan
description: Earthen adobe city of the Chimú near the Pacific coast.

name: Nazca Lines viewing tower
description: A roadside tower offers elevated views of selected Nazca geoglyphs.

name: Sacred Valley
description: Inca terraces, markets and villages along the Urubamba toward Machu Picchu.

name: Lake Titicaca
description: High-altitude lake shared with Bolivia; boat trips visit island communities.

name: Colca Canyon
description: A deep canyon known for Andean condor viewpoints and terraced villages.

name: Huacachina
description: An oasis lagoon ringed by sand dunes near Ica.

name: Miraflores Malecón
description: Cliff-top parks and paths overlook the Pacific in Miraflores.

name: Mercado San Camilo
description: Arequipa’s central market sells produce and Andean ingredients.

name: Mercado No. 1 Surquillo
description: A favourite Lima market for fruit, fish and juice counters.

name: Mercado San Pedro
description: Cusco’s busy market for juices, cheeses and local lunches.

name: Barranco cafés
description: Bohemian district of cafés, cevicherías and evening terraces.

name: Trujillo city eateries
description: Coastal northern kitchens known for ceviche and cabrito.

name: Inti Raymi
description: A June solstice festival reenacting Inca sun rites at Sacsayhuamán.
